payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compress consecutive duplicates; 2D DP over i,j: dp[i][j]=min ops to delete substring; base dp[i][i]=1; transition: 1+dp[i+1][j] or if a[i]==a[k] then dp[i][k-1]+dp[k+1][j].
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 2D array indexed by i and j, typical of dp_2d_state. The interval-like structure is subordinate to the two-dimensional state representation. This subtype matches the implementation exactly and has the highest candidate score.
